gloss: mass resignation; en bloc resignation (of a cabinet)

definitions.gloss: mass resignation; en bloc resignation (especially of a cabinet)
definitions.explanation: The simultaneous resignation of all members of a body — most often a national cabinet, but also a corporate board or committee. Often takes する.

examples.japanese: ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{総辞職|そうじしょく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総辞職|そうじしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表明|ひょうめい}→表明：14052_hyoumei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The prime minister announced the cabinet's en bloc resignation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大敗|たいはい}→大敗：08201_taihai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総辞職|そうじしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{余儀|よぎ}なく→余儀なく：28255_yoginaku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Following a crushing defeat in the election, the cabinet was forced to resign en masse.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧ (whole, all) + ⟦{辞職|じしょく}→辞職：06157_jishoku⟧ (resignation). Most commonly refers to the formal en bloc resignation of the Japanese cabinet — a constitutional event that occurs after a major election loss or a vote of no confidence. Often used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧{総辞職|そうじしょく}: cabinet en bloc resignation (a fixed term)
- {総辞職|そうじしょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to resign en masse
- {総辞職|そうじしょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれる→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧: to be driven to mass resignation
- {総辞職|そうじしょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表明|ひょうめい}→表明：14052_hyoumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to announce mass resignation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{辞職|じしょく}→辞職：06157_jishoku⟧: resignation — a single person resigning a post
- ⟦{退陣|たいじん}→退陣：25312_taijin⟧: stepping down — often used for a leader leaving office, with no implication of bringing the whole team down
- ⟦{解散|かいさん}→解散：04121_kaisan⟧: dissolution — used for the Diet/parliament, not the cabinet
